bite.title: Steel sport asks slipped again in August, and the accepted prices did not
bite.body: Asking prices on the four steel sport references we track fell for a third straight month on Calibre, down a further two per cent against July. What did not move is what those watches actually sold for: accepted offers held within a percentage point of where they sat in June. The gap is the story. Sellers are still opening high and meeting the market on the way down, which lengthens the time a listing sits without changing the number it eventually closes at. Full sets continue to close that gap fastest.
bite.author: Priya Raman

article.title: What changed in the autumn market
